reason: A Live2D web widget and Windows desktop companion that visualizes DSH session states, supports model and dialogue customization, and includes local board games with optional LLM commentary.

summaries.zh: 这是一个将 DeepSeek Harness 会话状态呈现为 Live2D 网页挂件或 Windows 桌宠的可配置监控面板，并提供模型管理、台词编辑和本地棋类游戏。
summaries.en: A configurable Live2D web widget or Windows desktop companion that visualizes DeepSeek Harness session states and provides model management, dialogue editing, and local board games.

capabilities: subscribes to DSH session and event streams
injects a web-based Live2D status widget
spawns and manages an Electron desktop companion window
reads and writes local model, profile, dialogue preset, and configuration files
calls an LLM for optional game commentary and moves
